title: Keep ensemble projection in a positivity claim even for a stable native boson model
statement: For the source stable two-site/two-flavor diagonal Hamiltonian U sum(nb-nc)²-mu(Nb+Nc), U>0,mu<0, every conjugate-field grand weight is nonnegative and the physical uncut grand partition finite. At phases pi/2,-pi/2 its total-number2 coefficient is-2r²<0 on a positive-measure neighborhood, while separately fixed(1,1) is a different coefficient. At r=1/2,beta U=ln2/2 the actual physical Z2=5/4,Z11=3/4 and Z20=Z02=1/4 remain positive.
